baseline: Exact v1.43 skill-regressed 2027 release; player history 2023–2026, fixed population priors through 2025
feature_definition: Official exported fraction of all BBE; BBE>=30 and existing v1.21 masks. Historical rows must additionally pass v1.22 RESEARCH_ELIGIBLE_RECONCILED_DEFINITION. No archive proxy substitution.
excluded_feature_families: direction/pull-air, EV, bat tracking, baserunning, pitch arsenal and other unresolved or short-history families are audited but not predictors
feature_pooling: Within prior four source years, BBE x 1:2:3:4 exposure weighting; all three metrics from a complete compatible source season; unknown not zero.
training: Identical residual model with newly supported training targets 2022–2025; each fit uses targets strictly earlier than origin, none from 2026.
model: Single fixed ridge per role, penalty 20, intercept unpenalized; earlier training-weighted standardization, z clipped [-4,4], sample weights=min(target denominator,600) normalized to mean 1; minimum100 training players/seasons. No hyperparameter or feature search.
application: Half predicted residual x frozen forecast denominator, capped to plus/minus half baseline count. Hitters adjust 1B/2B/3B while holding HR fixed and respecting AB; pitchers adjust SO/BB and recompute WHIP.
anchors: PA/AB/IP/OUTS, HR, pitcher H/ER/ERA/W/SV/HLD/G/GS/QS and hitter R/RBI/SB/BB/HBP/SF/SH unchanged; no workload, minor, park or international changes
guard_comparator: V1_43 versus STATCAST_RESEARCH using original phase.gate math; internal aliases weighted_actuals/skill_regression map to those arms only for executing unchanged guard code
historical_scoring: 2023,2024,2025 forecast folds; first training target2022 uses2021 compatible archived observations.
release_policy: Publish replayed baseline, exploratory candidate, adoption-gated candidate and long differences. Failed role gates or missing inputs retain entire baseline vector. Exploratory values never silently replace production.
2026_data_usage: 2027 player history/input audit only; frozen decision and model hashes written before opening holdout labels
limitations: At most one independent earlier-supported scoring origin with supplied official definitions
No new MLB opportunity for minor/international-only players
Metric eligibility differs and missing features are explicit
No inference that a CSV family existing means its scope is validated
source_2026_quality: Every admitted 2026 export bundle must match hash-verified full-season archived categorical counts and all-BBE denominator; mismatches excluded rather than repaired.
permitted_changes: Input source history extension and audit-based source exclusions only; predictor names/targets/ridge/scaling/pooling/damping/caps/priors/guards unchanged.
publication: Role gates establish statistical eligibility only; review largest player changes before considering production adoption. Working baseline stays immutable.
